name: scenario_0910
description: The user is managing historical medical and pharmaceutical documents, extracting key details and cross-referencing them with their local files, notes, and task lists to organize their research.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_4, image_6]
Query: Find the primary drug name in each of these three documents. Check if they are listed in my drugs to review file. For any that are missing, create a task to 'Review [Drug Name]' in my Reviews project.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to extract the main drug names from the three documents and check the 'drugs to review' file. For any drug not already in the file, it should create a task to review it in your 'Reviews' project. If the assistant asks which Reviews project you mean (since there are multiple), clarify that you mean the 'Drug Reviews' project. If it asks about spelling variations for the first document, tell it either spelling is fine. Once the tasks are created, confirm and move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_5]
Query: Now look at this new agenda to find the city it's held in. Also, remember the city where the congress from the Trimegestone document is taking place. Check my venues note. If either city is missing from the note, create a calendar event for next Friday at 1 PM to 'Call archives in [City]'.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the city from the new agenda and recall the city for the congress mentioned in the earlier Trimegestone document. It needs to check your 'venues' note and, for any city not listed, create a calendar event for next Friday at 1 PM to call the archives there. If the assistant asks whether you mean the 'Archived Venues' or 'Upcoming Venues' note, specify the archived one. Once the event is scheduled, acknowledge it and proceed.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_2, image_3]
Query: Finally, find the names of the people giving the 'Introduction' in these two schedules. Check my Historical Figures project and add anyone who isn't already there as a new task. Then, send an email to my supervisor listing the names of the newly added figures.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the two schedules and find the names of the individuals giving the 'Introduction'. It should cross-reference these names with your 'Historical Figures' project, add any missing names as new tasks, and then email your supervisor with the names of the newly added people. If the assistant asks who your supervisor is, remind them it's David. Once the email is sent, thank the assistant and end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='4' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='1,2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

entity_data.subject: Newly Added Historical Figures
entity_data.body:
Hi David,

I just wanted to let you know that I've added the following new name to our Historical Figures project:
- Emil Mrak

Best,
Kathryn

task_completion_criteria: Extract drug names (Tibolone/Tibolene, Trimegestone, Pioglitazone), event cities (London Gatwick/London, Yokohama), and speakers giving introductions (Dr. Dyar, Emil Mrak) from the provided documents. Cross-reference these with existing device data. Create Todoist tasks for missing drugs (Trimegestone, Pioglitazone) in the 'Drug Reviews' project, schedule a calendar event for next Friday at 1 PM to call archives for the missing city (London Gatwick/London), add the missing speaker (Emil Mrak) to the 'Historical Figures' project, and email the user's supervisor (David Martinez) about the newly added speaker.
